blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sandiganbayan Presiding Justice Geraldine Faith Econg on Tuesday called for a review of the Supreme Court doctrine that has raised the burden of proof in plunder cases involving public officials. Econg, who is among the candidates for a vacancy in the high tribunal, told a panel of the Judicial and Bar Council that it has been difficult for courts to convict the “main plunderer” in a case because of the so-called Arroyo doctrine. “[I] believe that rule in the Arroyo doctrine on plunder must be revisited and [reviewed] again.
